name: Kagami Jun
source:
Jun is an accomplished Shinto shrine maiden, and accordingly, is normally found performing religious duties within temples. She wields tremendous spiritual energies, and can directly combat demonic creatures with little fear of retribution. Shun is her cherished younger sister.

Hobby: Cooking
Talent: Making Tea
Likes: Green Tea
Dislikes: Impure Souls

[From Nargrakhan's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175407/http://www.elizar.com/?p=16]review[/url]]
